educationalGoal: ・letter: to surely and beautifully write by understanding the constitution of Korean. ・pronunciation: practice the pronunciation of hangul. ・grammar: learn rudimentary grammar. ・vocabulary: to freely use the most important 300 words. ・everyday expression: Learn about 100 commonly used expressions.
advice: 1. For students who learn Korean for the first time. It is a subject that fosters basic knowledge and opearating power 2. On Korean based on the class plan. 3. For beginners, Hangul is the music score. 4. Learn the basis for text and pronunciation. 5. Minimize grammar learning 6. Study the four functions of reading, writing, listening, and speaking in a balanced manner 7. Learn about culture, customs, history, and social situations through audiovisual media so that the world of Korean becomes familiar
books: Beautiful Korea, Beautiful Korean School. Dictionary Korean-Japanese
requiredKnowledge: ・Try to prepare and review classes and get used to new words. ・Study the four functions of reading, writing, listening, and speaking in a balanced manner. ・Try to memorize vocabulary ・Make sure to take notes.

activityGoals.body: Be able to read and write Hangul
Be able to know the basic pronunciation system, and accurately use initial sound, medial, final consonant.
Be able to understand the basic structure and function of Korean and use it correctly.
Be able to the language necessary for life, such as greetings, self-introduction, and numbers.
Be able to part of the Hangul system and talk about location and location.
Be able to self- assessment of the behavioral goals that students must achieve in this subject.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・You can write and read the vowel and consonant of Hangul. ・You can introduce a simple greeting or introduce yourself. ・You want to pronounce and become able to speak. ・You can ask and ask what you want to know, hear and see, respond to numbers, use numbers, and do shopping.
achievementLevels.standard: You can learn basic grammar items and have basic conversations such as simple greetings and self-introductions.
